scripts.models:prepare: uv run --project backend --extra local python backend/manage.py prepare_models
scripts.models:check: uv run --project backend --extra local python backend/manage.py check_models
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project backend --env-file .env uvicorn config.asgi:application --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4412 --reload
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait db-pgvector redis mailpit
scripts.migrate: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py migrate
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @lattice/web lint && uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.test: node --test scripts/project.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @lattice/web test && uv run --project backend pytest backend
